paper_title: 3D Printing of Individualized Microfluidic Chips with DLP-Based Printer
value: 64 % day 1 falling to 32 % day 4 on the bare chip; >85 % from day 2 with GelMA coating
evidence: Results: "The cell viability decreases from 64.03 ± 2.70% on the first day to 32.13 ± 5.56% on the fourth day. In contrast, the chip treated with GelMA gel ... on the 2nd, 3rd, and 4th days, the cell viability remains above 85%". The extractor had taken the ±2.70 % standard deviation.
